observations: Prediction defines smaller-left/larger-right partition and zero-based position for pivot five.
A learner-chosen placement order happened to sort both sides, producing 1 2 3 5 7 8 9 before recursive partition.
Reset and input-order placement produced genuinely unsorted sides 2 1 3 and 7 9 8 while pivot remained at position three.
Partitioning sides yielded sorted row without moving five; reveal explains smaller-value count, independent subproblems and bad first-pivot sorted-input case.

complexity.reason: Rank and recursive partitions need abstraction.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Distinguish one fixed element from an ordered whole.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Six placement buttons, partition and reset.

whyCool: Counting what belongs on each side fixes one card forever, even while its neighbors remain scrambled.
caveat: Unique fixed values; duplicate handling and editable pivot choice are not explored. Some placement orders accidentally pre-sort the sides.
effort: Prediction, two full placement orders with reset, unsorted-side screenshot, recursive partition and reveal.
bucketReason: Tested rank invariant across placement order and clear recursive explanation.

prediction.reason: Precise rank question with clear indexing.
prediction.evidence: Position two, three or four; exactly three smaller values.

interaction.reason: Different placement orders and reset test invariant despite side-order variation.
interaction.evidence: Already-sorted sides versus unsorted sides, same pivot rank.

payoff.reason: Explains rank, recursive independence and a meaningful performance condition.
payoff.evidence: Three smaller values fix pivot; balanced splits versus empty-side quadratic case.

clarity.reason: Indexed row and fixed pivot make the partial-result distinction visible.
clarity.evidence: Unsorted sides around final five before recursive step.

transfer.reason: General recursive rule with a specific limiting input.
transfer.evidence: Nothing crosses pivot; sorted input with first pivot creates empty pile.

surprise.reason: A final position can be established before sorting the rest.
surprise.evidence: Five fixed while two-one and nine-eight remain inverted.

visualExplanation.evidence: Pivot marked home before side partition.
